svg.title: The framework's two sites in Azure: what runs where

g.text: The framework's two sites in Azure: what runs where
louis-agent-env, Consumption, asleep at no replicas
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: Two apps in one environment in rg-louis-agent-za, on no network of ours, each asleep until someone visits:
they share an identity that reads the vault and a share that holds each one's logs in a folder of its own.
